verdict.rationale: Semgrep's CLI (`semgrep ci`/`semgrep scan`) runs fully headlessly and supports machine-readable outputs like SARIF/JSON export, plus documented integration for creating tickets/alerts from findings (Triage findings feature) and an AppSec Platform API to gather findings for downstream automation. This gives an agent a clear scan→parse→file-issue pipeline usable in CI/pre-commit contexts. Missing for 10: an explicit worked example of an agent script consuming JSON/SARIF output and auto-filing issues, and independent hands-on confirmation of the ticket-creation integration.
